sample.question:
Rules:
1. The image shows a standard Tetris grid with 12 rows and 12 columns.
2. The number and categories of actions done to the falling tetromino are not restricted, which means you can perform unlimited rotations and translations (moving left, right, or down) to position the tetromino as needed. 
3. Only consider rows cleared in this turn.
4. There may not be active tetromino(colored in red) falling in the image.


Question:
What's the maximum number of rows can be cleared after positioning the active Tetrimino in this turn?
sample.analysis:
From the image we can see a falling red Tetrimino. The red tetromino has three blocks in a horizontal line with one block extending up on the right. So this is an L-shape tetromino rotated 270° clockwise.

By placing the 4 blocks of tetromino at [(9, 9), (10, 9), (11, 9), (11, 10)], 1 row can be cleared at rows [11]. This is the maximum possible number of rows that can be cleared with any valid placement of the current tetromino.
